SEI_Chemical_Composition_XPS.source_text: XPS analysis was implemented to visually demonstrate the successful coating of EVOH. As shown in Fig. S2a, the C 1 s spectra displayed two fitting peaks at the binding energy of 284.5 and 290.5 eV, assigned to C C C-C bond and pi - pi excitation, respectively. Another peak located at 285.4 eV was related to the small amount of functional group of C-OH, originating from the trace amount of in the graphite powder 45. After EVOH coating, the C-OH bond was strengthened in Fig. S2b due to hydroxyl groups of EVOH, further supported by O 1 s spectrum in Fig. 2g. These observations indicated more hydroxyl groups were introduced by EVOH.
